reason: I am eager to automate our morning WhatsApp document flood, but my article clerks rotate every couple of years and retraining them on a complex operating system is an ongoing drain. Until adoption is completely effortless for fresh trainees without partner handholding, I cannot justify paying for an annual subscription.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time.
would_change_my_mind: A zero-learning-curve interface that rotating article clerks can use on day one without any training, allowing WhatsApp dumps to triage directly into structured Drive folders.
